Aesthetic & Design Language:
- Modern corporate SaaS aesthetic with premium e-learning polish (Linear, Stripe, Coursera Enterprise quality).
- Clean, authoritative, trustworthy, crisp typography with Inter, refined 8px spatial rhythm, 12px rounded cards with crisp subtle borders (slate-200) and soft layered shadows.
- Colors: Slate-50 (#F8FAFC) background bands, pure white (#FFFFFF) elevated cards, Indigo-600 (#4F46E5) primary brand accents, Deep Navy (#0F172A) accents and dark elements, Amber-400 (#FBBF24) star ratings, Emerald-500 (#10B981) completion/success badges.

Page Structure & Key Sections:
1. Hero Section:
   - Subtle indigo/slate tinted background band with micro-grid pattern.
   - Left side: Pill badge 'NEW COHORT ENROLLING • Q3 Executive Data Track', bold commanding headline 'Master Data Skills That Drive Your Career', authoritative copy on professional coaching for Excel, Power Query, SQL, and Python for business analysts and managers.
   - Primary CTA 'Explore Courses' (indigo button with arrow icon) + Secondary ghost button 'Get Started Free'.
   - Social proof inline: 5 amber stars + 'Rated 4.9/5 by 12,000+ data professionals from Fortune 500 teams'.
   - Right side: High-fidelity interactive mockup visual representing a sleek analytics workspace / financial modeling sandbox (clean code preview with Pandas/SQL, execution badge 'SQL Query Executed 12ms', variance analysis graph curve, and verified credential badge).

2. Key Metrics & Impact Bar:
   - 4-column metric counter bar: '12,000+' Students Trained & Certified, '25+' Practical Specialization Courses, '96%' Career Advancement Rate, '4.8 / 5.0' Average Review Rating with amber stars.

3. Featured Masterclasses (Course Catalog):
   - Category filter pills: All, Excel & Power Query, SQL & Databases, Python & Automation, BI Dashboards.
   - 4 premium course cards in a clean row:
     a) 'Advanced Excel Masterclass' - Advanced badge, 18.5 hrs • 42 lessons, Sarah Jenkins (Ex-McKinsey Lead), 4.9 (3,820 reviews), $89 (was $149, 40% OFF).
     b) 'Power Query & Automated ETL' - Intermediate badge, 14 hrs • 30 lessons, Marcus Chen (Principal BI Architect), 4.8 (1,890 reviews), $79 (was $129, 38% OFF).
     c) 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis' - All Levels badge, 22 hrs • 56 lessons, Elena Rostova (Senior Data Engineer), 4.9 (4,150 reviews), $99 (was $169, 41% OFF).
     d) 'Python for Business Dashboards' - Intermediate badge, 26 hrs • 64 lessons, David Kalu (Head of Data Science), 4.8 (2,640 reviews), $119 (was $199, 40% OFF).
   - Each card features crisp preview header, instructor avatar + title, level tags, duration, pricing breakdown, and quick action icon.

4. Targeted Paths / Explore by Specialization:
   - 6 structured roadmap tiles with specialized icons:
     * Advanced Excel (Complex Nested Formulas, VBA Macros, Financial Modeling)
     * Power Query (ETL Pipelines, Advanced M-Code, Multi-Source Merges)
     * SQL Analytics (PostgreSQL, Window Functions, CTEs, BigQuery Performance)
     * Python for Data (Pandas, NumPy, Hypothesis Testing, Jupyter Workflows)
     * Business Dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Executive Reporting, Board-Deck Storytelling)
     * Career Prep & Portfolios (Technical Mock Interviews, Live Portfolio Defense, Senior Analyst Mentorship)

5. The BICE Difference ('Why Learn With Us'):
   - 3 clean benefit cards:
     * Expert Practitioner Instructors (Every module crafted by active VP and Director-level data professionals)
     * Hands-on Capstone Projects (Real-world messy CSVs, reconciliations, interactive dashboards)
     * Industry-Recognized Certification (Accredited completion credentials verifiable on LinkedIn)

6. Faculty Spotlight:
   - Featured mentor profile: David Miller (Former Senior Data Director at Stripe & FinTech Unicorn), 15+ years experience, 45,000+ students mentored, inspiring quote on actionable data communication, and CTA link to meet all 12 instructors.

7. Student Outcomes & Social Proof:
   - 3 authentic testimonial cards from graduates working at Deloitte, Stripe, and CapitalOne, including full star ratings, verified corporate roles, and specific career impact notes.

8. Frequently Asked Questions (Interactive Accordion):
   - 5 comprehensive FAQ items regarding prerequisites, self-paced vs cohort cadence, certificate accreditation, corporate licensing, and capstone mentor support.

9. Newsletter & Insights Callout:
   - Dark navy / indigo container band: 'Stay Ahead of the Data Curve', bi-weekly breakdown of real-world Excel tips, SQL recipes, and M-code patterns, clean email input form with 'Subscribe Free' CTA
